title: BermLaunch — what it is, what it unlocks, and how anyone checks it
one_line: A token launchpad where a creator hands a share of their own trading fees to named people — before the token exists, at graduation, or years later — and nobody, including the creator, can take it back.

core_primitive.name: pocket
core_primitive.definition: A permanent, proportional claim on a fee stream, owned by a key.
core_primitive.is: a range inside a fee stream that grows automatically as value arrives

vs_airdrop.airdrop: one-time gift, decided afterwards, by the giver; you hope you qualify
vs_airdrop.pocket: continuous claim, decided beforehand, enforced by arithmetic
vs_airdrop.difference: whether the promise exists as a fact or as an intention

three_moments.why: the hardest supporters to reward — at that point there is no token and no way to pay anyone, so historically you promise

three_moments.when: when the bonding curve completes and a real pool exists
three_moments.why: the moment early supporters historically get flattened
a good arrival at month eight has no reason to be less real than a day-one supporter

economics.headline: 60% of all trading fees to 450 people, permanently; 40% to the creator

allocation_formula.body: mulDiv(total, end, denominator) - mulDiv(total, start, denominator)
allocation_formula.visibility: public pure — anyone can call it and check their own share
allocation_formula.property: adjacent ranges telescope exactly; no dust, no rounding remainder, no residual pool

fee_intake.route: Bags trading fees -> fee share -> Distributor as SOLE claimer at 10000 bps
verified_at_bind: token exists with curve and pool
fee_intake.harvest: harvest() is permissionless; syncExternalDeposit() picks up value arriving by other routes
fee_intake.irreversibility: launchBound is one-shot; zero unbind or rebind paths exist (verified)

operating_fee.purpose: pay a service out of the stream rather than out of pocket
operating_fee.rationale: a fee that can be raised later is not a fee, it is an option on your revenue

freezes: the finalizer authority itself, permanently retired

use_cases.name: Community before the token exists
use_cases.why: no alternative exists today — you cannot pay from a token that does not exist

use_cases.name: Paying a service from the stream
use_cases.holder: DEX, market maker, auditor, infrastructure provider
use_cases.why: paid from the stream means aligned with the stream; capped and immutable means both sides can verify the deal

use_cases.name: Co-launch partner
use_cases.why: binds the relationship into the contract rather than into a Telegram message

use_cases.name: KOL paid from the creator's own slice
use_cases.mechanically: subdividing the creator range telescopes identically, zero dust
use_cases.blocked_by: the v1 constitution does not encode creator sub-splits

use_cases.name: Moderators on a recurring basis
use_cases.shape: weekly or monthly, must stop when the work stops
use_cases.needs: a second allocation dimension — epochs or versioned roots with an activation point
use_cases.open_question: what happens when nobody rolls the epoch: does the moderator keep earning, or does everything halt
use_cases.risk_note: that unanswered fallback is the same shape as the worst bug this project has found
use_cases.legal_note: recurring payment for ongoing work is compensation-shaped rather than fee-share-shaped and deserves qualified review

use_cases.name: Contributor pocket
use_cases.holder: a developer paid from the stream instead of a grant

use_cases.name: Reciprocal pocket
use_cases.holder: two projects each holding a slice of the other

use_cases.name: Tradeable pocket — the credit / claim split
use_cases.question: could a pocket be an NFT, so it can be sold
use_cases.mechanism_safe: a wrapper contract accepts a deposit of the claim right and mints an ERC-721; no leaf-schema change, no new constitution, no migration
use_cases.mechanism_clean: leaf binds slot -> tokenId; changes root law, so a v2 campaign and never a retrofit
use_cases.why_naive_version_breaks_the_product: a purchasable pocket separates the payout from the person permanently and by design; the buyer has no audience, made no noise and brought nobody, so fifty purchasable Founding slots are a pre-sale rather than a supporter cohort

credit.lives: inside the sealed root, bound to the npub

what_the_split_preserves: the honour roll stays true forever whatever happens to the cash flow
the exposure already happened and is recorded
the Nostr community graph is untouched because it is keyed to npubs
use_cases.gap_it_closes: today a supporter needing liquidity can only convert and sell through the buyback, exiting the token; a transferable claim lets them exit the stream while the stream continues
use_cases.secondary_benefit: price discovery — a Founding slot trading at X is a legible signal about the mechanism
use_cases.before_it_is_built: transferability is the specific property that changes the legal shape; a non-transferable claim received for participating differs from a transferable instrument paying a proportional share of revenue from a common enterprise. Take advice before, not after. This is not an engineering judgement.

creator_flow: deploy the Distributor — parameters immutable from this instant
launch atomically — any invariant failure reverts everything
waive the manager role and publish the transaction
let people enroll — never assign membership
creator_cannot_ever: introduce a deadline or expiry on anyone's entitlement
supporter_flow: get an identity — existing signer, or generate and download the encrypted file (not optional)
enroll with one signature including proof of address control
get a slot from published snapshots — you are in the batch where you were seen
wait or don't — entitlement accrues with no window and no deadline
claim when you want, with no account, no approval, and no requirement that our website is reachable
supporter_trusts: Bags, who can rewrite the fee configuration upstream
the observer key that orders rebindings before finalization
supporter_trust_note: That is the complete list. If the fee stream fails it fails for the creator too, which makes the arrangement honest, not safe.

five_checks.proves: membership can never be changed again
the rules on chain are the rules published
fees cannot reach anyone else from Bags' side
the service cut cannot be raised on you

five_checks.check: your leaf verifies against a sealed root
five_checks.proves: your share is committed and computable

verification.evidence_chain: signed enrollment events -> deterministic snapshot and cutoff -> cohort selection law -> canonical roster -> wallet binding -> evidence manifest -> Merkle root -> finalization -> seal
verification.explorer_rule: a reproduced root does not mean every destination was proven; the explorer refuses to merge those questions
cannot_tell_you: that Bags will not rewrite the fee configuration
that the token will be worth anything
that a market route will be available when you claim — entitlement is preserved, not exit price

invariants: No address enters a payout list without proof of control.
Nothing renders as verified that was not verified.
Entitlement does not expire and cannot be swept.
Claiming never requires our website, our account, or our permission.
invariant_rule: A feature that would break one of these does not ship, however good it is.
